scope: Real isolated MySQL schema and panel HTTP/service tests; Wings transport mocked. No live panel deployment or full-quota OVH run.
unknown_dispatch: A separate SQL connection sees the committed reservation before a forced Wings timeout; retry is refused and the original remains.
concurrency: Two independent processes; one winner for both empty-server creation and full-quota replacement.
conditional_deletion: Preserved recovery metadata is checked under the server lock; deleted, foreign, self, incomplete and malformed preserved identities reject deletion.
